_: Tier-3 orbit scene (DECISIONS.md CR-14). Config here, never in the logic. Read at build time and emitted as data attributes - no runtime fetch.
_featured: The games that lead the page, shown as their standalone ATTRACT SCREENS (game law 5b) rather than as embedded games. An attract asset is purpose-built to run with no input and to paint immediately, which an embedded game does not guarantee. A featured slug with no attract/index.html is DROPPED by the build and reported - the same discipline as requireCanvas.
_requireCanvas: Only include a registry entry whose page actually contains a <canvas>. This exists because /games/fulfillment/ is 'Fulfillment - Manual' - 4.5MB of documentation with no canvas and no animation loop - and it was shipped into an arcade cabinet. A games scene is built from things that are games, and the build proves it rather than trusting a category field.
_starCount: Background field. Three parallax depths are derived from this.
_orbitSpeed: Radians per second at the innermost ring. Outer rings are slower, so the field reads as depth rather than a spinning plate.
_hoverRadius: Pointer distance in px at which a body wakes. Generous on purpose - hunting for a 13px target is not a feature.
_labelAlways: Draw every name at all times. A scene where you must hover to find out what anything is fails the bible's rule against making people win a game to reach basic information.
_driftAmp: Idle bob, in px. Small. It should read as alive, not as drifting away.
